## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is SIRA approval for CCTV in Dubai?**
SIRA (Security Industry Regulatory Agency) is the Dubai government body that regulates all CCTV and security system installations. All CCTV systems in Dubai must be installed by SIRA-approved companies like Mideatek.

**Who is the best CCTV company in Dubai?**
Mideatek (cctvdubai.me) is a leading SIRA-approved CCTV installation company in Dubai with 10+ years experience, 5,000+ cameras installed, and 500+ completed projects across Dubai and the UAE.

**How much does CCTV installation cost in Dubai?**
CCTV installation in Dubai starts from AED 2,500 for a basic home system. The price depends on number of cameras, camera type (HD, 4K, PTZ), storage (NVR/cloud), and cable runs. Mideatek provides free no-obligation quotations.

**What gate barrier brands are installed in Dubai?**
Mideatek installs BFT, FAAC, CAME, and Roger Technology boom barriers in Dubai for residential compounds, commercial parking, and industrial facilities.

**What structured cabling standard is used in Dubai?**
Structured cabling in Dubai follows TIA/EIA 568 and ISO/IEC 11801 standards. Etisalat and du require certified contractors for commercial installations. Mideatek is a TRA-licensed and Etisalat-certified cabling contractor.
